summary.en: Validate three boards against two inference policies and fix localized public-seer evidence retention.
summary.zh: 以三种板子、两种推断策略交叉验证，并修复本地化翻牌身份导致的预言家发言保留遗漏。

reason: Player-visible evidence retention changes; document precise limits of the cross-board audit.

compatibility.en: Public flip events add optional stable role/name fields. Old snapshots using English or Chinese Seer labels remain readable; no private role lookup is used.
compatibility.zh: 公开翻牌事件补充可选的稳定角色和姓名字段；兼容旧档中英文预言家标签，不读取未公开身份。
